name: Akashic Catalyst
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 5th; Slot see text; Price varies (least 8,000 gp, lesser 32,000 gp, greater 72,800 gp); Weight —

DESCRIPTION

Bands of woven cloth studded with gems, em1broidered with strings of metal forming faintly glowing mandalas.

When you wear an akashic catalyst in one of the following item slots in which you also have a veil shaped, it reinforces and empowers the veil’s essence: hands, feet, head, headband, ring, shoulders, wrist, neck, belt, chest, or body.

Any veils shaped in the slot in which you wear an akashic catalyst are treated as if they were invested with additional essence based on the strength of the akashic catalyst (+1 least, +2 lesser, +3 greater). This increase can cause such a veil to be treated as if it were invested with a greater amount of essence than your essence capacity, and this increase does not count as essence in your essence pool. If you have multiple veils shaped in that slot, they are all affected.

If an akashic catalyst affects a veil that isn’t invested with essence directly (such as a daevic’s passion veil, or a soulforge’s soul veil) it still affects that veil, treating the essence receptacle affecting that veil as if it were invested with more essence for that veil. This only affects the veil sharing a slot with the akashic catalyst, not all veils associated with the essence receptacle.

You cannot wear more than one akashic catalyst of each type (least, lesser, and greater). Putting on or taking off an akashic catalyst is a full round action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, creator must possess an essence pool; Cost varies (least 4,000 gp, lesser 16,000 gp, Greater 36,000 gp)
